Manage All Your Health Care Needs With the MyMethodist App

Have a question for your doctor? Feeling sick and need care now? With the MyMethodist app, our experts are just a click away. Download the app and get the fast track to: 

 

  • Access your MyChart account to schedule an appointment, message your provider or check test results
  • Get 24/7 on-demand video visits with Virtual Urgent Care
  • Find a new doctor or specialist for your personal care needs through Find a Doctor
  • Schedule online at our Same Day Clinics and other care locations
Learn More & Download the App Here

Research & Innovation

At Houston Methodist, fostering innovations with the potential for clinical application is at the very heart of what we do — allowing us to bring cutting-edge treatments to patients faster. Our deep commitment to finding new ways to prevent and treat illness to improve the health of our patients means that our primary goal is to make a clinical trial available to every person who needs and wants to participate in one.

Pricing Transparency

In compliance with the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) guidelines, Houston Methodist has made publicly available a comprehensive list of our gross charges, negotiated rates, cash-discounted rates, and minimum and maximum negotiated rates for all hospital services across the health system. In general, it is useful to distinguish between gross charge and negotiated rate. Gross charge relates to the price that is billed to all patients, regardless of insurance coverage. Negotiated rate relates to the dollar amount an insurance company agrees to pay for the service. Final gross charges will be based on many factors, such as the time spent in surgery and recovery, specific equipment and supplies and/or implants used, additional tests required by the physician, and/or any special care or unexpected conditions or complications.

Prices are subject to change without notice and are updated annually.

Keep Your Employees Healthy & Productive

Houston Methodist offers collaborative solutions to help your entire organization. These ideas capitalize on our strengths in patient-centered services, and promise each of your employees outstanding treatment throughout the entire Houston Methodist experience. Our experts and our vast scope of high-quality, specialized services highlight our commitment to offering the best possible care.

 

We partner with more than 450 organizations representing several industries, population sizes and locations to help them achieve customized health care goals. 

Executive Health

For busy executives, we offer 3 comprehensive health assessment packages — all focused on preventive care. When needed, we can provide additional specialty services to help make their health a priority without leaving the office for multiple appointments. 

Wellness

We have extensive experience creating a culture of wellness in the workplace — internally for our estimated 27,000 employees and externally for clients. Many wellness services can be provided on-site at your organization.

Dedicated Mammogram Dates at Nearby Breast Care Centers

The Houston Methodist Breast Care Center team, comprised of expert mammogram technicians, nurses and breast radiologists, hosts a dedicated screening mammogram time at one of our eight locations for the women of your organization.

Virtual Care

We offer options in telemedicine, including virtual urgent care for non-emergency conditions via on-demand video visits; MyChart E-visits for same-day sick visits via online messaging; and MyChart video visit appointments with our doctors.

Corporate Athletic Training

Houston Methodist’s highly trained athletic trainers specialize in prevention, emergency care, evaluation, treatment and rehabilitation of injuries.

Occupational Medicine (Baytown)

Our occupational health care providers offer customized, streamlined care for Baytown-area employees with our pre-employment exams, travel preparation, regulatory exams, and injury care and follow-up.

Second Opinions

Houston Methodist facilitates second opinions for national and international employees, which can minimize the need for costly travel.

Facilitated Access

Our clients receive direct access to patient liaisons trained to recommend specialists, schedule appointments and coordinate care.

U.S. News & World Report has named Houston Methodist Hospital the Best Hospital in Texas for 15 years in a row and recognized us as a nationally ranked Honor Roll hospital 10 times.

About Houston Methodist

About Houston Methodist

For more than 100 years, a legacy of medical milestones has attracted patients from around the world to Houston Methodist. What began as a small 100-bed hospital is now a leading academic medical center in the Texas Medical Center along with seven hospitals located throughout the Greater Houston area. Here is our story.

A History of Medical Achievements

For more than a century, life-changing medical milestones have attracted patients from around the country and around the world to Houston Methodist — where our leading experts deliver the most advanced medical and surgical solutions to every patient who walks through our doors. Scroll through the timeline below to learn more about our achievements.


Centennial Documentary

As part of our Centennial Celebration in 2019, Houston Methodist produced a documentary video chronicling important medical and organizational milestones. The film takes viewers on a journey of the challenges and triumphs the hospital faced all while maintaining one constant throughout the 100 years: A laser focus on our patients. 

About Our Organization

Houston Methodist comprises a leading academic medical center in the Texas Medical Center and seven community hospitals serving the Greater Houston area. Each hospital is staffed by committed personnel who exemplify our I CARE values of integrity, compassion, accountability, respect and excellence. Patient safety, quality and service are our highest priorities. 
Houston Methodist Health Care System

Our health system consists of eight acute-care hospitals: Houston Methodist Hospital, our flagship in the Texas Medical Center and seven hospitals located throughout Greater Houston (Baytown, Clear Lake, Cypress, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, West Houston and Willowbrook), as well as one long-term acute care hospital. Houston Methodist Hospital is consistently listed among U.S. News & World Report's best hospitals, and that same quality care extends across the system. Other centers include Emergency Care Centers, Imaging Centers, Breast Care Centers, Comprehensive Care Centers, Surgery Center and our Outpatient Center.

Houston Methodist Academic Institute

Houston Methodist Academic Institute is home to some of the world’s brightest physician-scientists, working in a collaborative environment on more than 800 clinical trials. The goal of the research institute is to quickly translate what is discovered in the lab into treatments for patients. The research institute is making great strides, bringing us even closer to medical breakthroughs in cardiovascular disease, cancer, infectious disease, neurosciences, diabetes and more.

Houston Methodist Physician Organization — Primary and Specialty Care

We employ more than 1,800 clinicians — comprised of mid-level providers, APPs and physicians in the Houston Methodist Physician Organization — at more than 265 practice locations across the Greater Houston area. Our Physician Organization is made up of our Houston Methodist Specialty Physician Group and Houston Methodist Primary Care Group, one of the largest employed primary care groups in the Houston area, with more than 40 locations and 250 practitioners dedicated to providing quality primary care for the entire family.

Houston Methodist Hospital Foundation

The Houston Methodist Hospital Foundation was established to ensure that Houston Methodist has the support needed to achieve its vision for excellence in research, education and patient care. Governed by a board of directors, the foundation helps to accomplish institutional priorities through fundraising, gift management and stewardship. Our achievements can be attributed to the generosity of our donors, who support our Leading Medicine vision.

What Makes Us Houston Methodist

Houston Methodist is a national leader in health care for so many reasons: Our dedication to medical excellence and innovation, our cutting-edge research and education, our outstanding leadership, doctors, nurses and support staff, our deep commitment to our community, our strong values and culture of inclusive behavior, and, more than anything else, the fact that we put our patients at the center of everything we do.

  • Our Values: What We Believe

    Our mission is to provide high quality, cost-effective health care that delivers the best value to the people we serve in a spiritual environment of caring in association with internationally recognized teaching and research. 

    Our I CARE values are at the heart of our mission and are what sets Houston Methodist apart from other health care systems.

     

    • Integrity – We are honest and ethical in all we say and do.
    • Compassion – We embrace the whole person and respond to emotional, ethical and spiritual concerns as well as physical needs.
    • Accountability – We hold ourselves accountable for our actions.
    • Respect – We treat every individual as a person of worth, dignity and value.
    • Excellence – We strive to be the best at what we do and be a model for others to emulate.

  • Culture & Engagement

    Houston Methodist is committed to having a culture of inclusive behavior that allows us to provide unparalleled, personalized care and service to a diverse patient population through effective teamwork, while ensuring dignity and respect for every patient, provider, colleague and our community.

    Houston Methodist President and CEO Marc Boom, MD, says it best: “Houston is one of the most diverse cities in the country, and Houston Methodist is a reflection of our city. Our employees represent all walks of life, fostering a rich exchange of ideas and knowledge that leads to the new and bold innovations and treatments that are at the heart of leading medicine.”

     

    Learn More About Culture & Engagement at Houston Methodist ➝

     

  • Grounded in Strong Leadership 

    Houston Methodist’s Board of Directors oversees the hospital’s activities and executive decisions, playing an enormous role in how we are leading medicine — in Houston, Texas, the nation and around the world. See Our Board of Directors ➝

  • Serving the Community Beyond Our Hospital Walls

    Houston Methodist has a responsibility to provide high-quality health care to those in need, regardless of their circumstances. Our Office of Community Benefits focuses on providing access to high quality, affordable health care services to indigent populations across Greater Houston while ensuring health equity for racial, ethnic and social minorities.

    Learn More ➝

  • Helping Balance Economic Viability, Social Equity & Environmental Protection

    With a focus on green initiatives, Houston Methodist’s Office of Sustainability is leading the charge in reducing the organization's carbon footprint and promoting sustainable practices throughout the organization. By prioritizing sustainability, we are not only making a positive impact on the environment, but also setting an example for other organizations to follow.
